linkedin.about: From humble beginnings to a self-made multimillionaire with over $6 billion to date in global product sales and a starring role on ABC’s newest business reality TV show, Shark Tank, Daymond John is the personification of the American Dream. He continues to set standards of excellence while expanding his interests in fashion, branding, marketing, consulting, entertainment, and beyond. This industry leader, best-selling author, and ground breaking entrepreneurial expert has evolved into a highly sought after business and motivational speaker. As a dynamic business speaker with over twenty years of hands-on proven business experience, Daymond shares the strategies that continue to bring him financial success. As Founder and CEO, Daymond steered FUBU from a mere concept to a global fashion powerhouse with annual retail sales exceeding $350 million at its peak. Utilizing many of the same tactics commonly used today, Daymond John pioneered the art of integrating fashion, culture, and music nearly twenty years ago. From his then unprecedented guerrilla marketing and branding techniques to the continuously innovative ways in which he uses social media, brand integration, and his expertise on pop culture, Daymond remains a cutting edge business strategist. Daymond teaches audience members how to apply his successful methods to a wide range of businesses today. He shares winning tips for negotiating and negotiating for women, boosting sales, improving employee morale, increasing productivity, and optimizing staff talents. As a motivational speaker, Daymond’s quintessential rags-to-riches success story of sacrifice, hard work, and perseverance as well as the unique and charismatic way he communicates it, will inspire any audience. Specialties: • Business Strategy • International Business Branding • Branding Expert • Celebrity Alignment • Brand Development • Brand Management • National & International C-Suite Consulting • Designer • Marketing • Motivational Speaker • Author

posts.caption:
MEET MY TEAM

You see me everywhere. Making all these investments, I could not do it without my team at The Shark Group.

This is what I mean when I talk about maximizing and triangulating our divisions. Seven divisions, seven ways to work with us:

Shark Investors — where the deals get done
Shark Speakers — where the stages get rocked
Brand Partners — where the infuse brands into the conversation 
@theshark_art — where artists get seen
CEO Access — where leaders connect
@sharkgevity — where we invest in longevity
Shark Licensing — where brands grow
You can have the vision, but you need the right people around you to bring it to life. 

Much love to my team @thesharkgroup  I appreciate every one of you! 👊🏾

IS MARK BACK ON @sharktankabc?!?!

He might be back to take his seat… Or he might not. 

Find out TONIGHT during the 2-hour #SharkTank season premiere at 9/8c on ABC and stream on Hulu.
Stop doing these things with your pitches until you hear this.

If you (or your boss) has built a company doing $100M+ a year, this might just be for you. Because once you reach that level, more information usually isn’t what moves the needle.

Access does. Access to the right opportunities, the right relationships, the right rooms and the right positioning, so people know your value before you ever walk through the door. That’s why I created CEO Access. I work directly with a hand-selected group of CEOs who have already proven they know how to build and scale. They don’t need me to teach them how to run their business.

My job is to help them expand what’s possible through new business opportunities, strategic introductions, personal branding, thought leadership, and access to relationships and rooms that could change the trajectory of what they’re building. This is not a mastermind.
It’s not a networking group and it’s definitely not for everybody.

But if you’ve built a company doing $100M+ a year and believe your next level could come from stronger positioning, better access, and bigger opportunities, I want to hear from you.

Apply for CEO Access at CEOAccess.com or through the link in my bio.

I personally work with a limited number of CEOs, and every application is reviewed.
This might just be for you.

Comparison will rob you faster than any thief.

I've seen billionaires cry on private jets and I've seen people build empires out of nothing.. I was one of them.

It's not what you have. It's what you MAKE out of it. The day you stop looking sideways is the day you start moving forward.

This is your reminder to  be grateful for what you got, and make the MOST out of it.

Gary’s @theultimatesnooze and Jack’s @essentiaorganicmattress are game changers that don’t have any of these dangerous chemicals in them. And no, I’m not an investor in either. I’m just a fan. I believe that @dave.asprey also works w essentia

You spend roughly a third of your life in bed. So When it’s time to replace your mattress, whether it’s Gary’s, Jack’s, or another quality organic option, I highly suggest doing your homework and considering the switch. @sharkgevity

“As long as you can stand. Never forget to take a moment to dance with the ones you love”

And on National Daughters Day, I’m reminded just how fast all of this goes.

That was said to me by one of my mentors shortly before he passed away. And I will never forget how subtle yet powerful that statement was. 

I started doing it with Minka back when we had that odd thing called COVID locked up in our house a couple years back. Can you even believe that happened? 🤷🏾‍♂️🤦🏾

@minkajaggerjohn was about five. We danced our way through it.

She has grown so much since then. But we're still dancing.

As we all struggle to find work life balance. It doesn't have to mean big vacations and long trips, sometimes it's just a moment your home with the music up and the ones you love. 🕺🏾💃🏻🧑🏼‍🩰

I’m almost 60, and I’m paying closer attention to my health now than ever. The testing, the recovery, the biohacking, the numbers... I want to know what’s going on with MY body.

Same goes for your money, your business and your family. Pay attention. Ask questions. Do your homework.
